content: आरक्ष {%a.%} Preserved, defended, fit to be protected. .{@-क्षः, -क्षा@} .²1 Protection, preservation, guard; आरक्षस्य विधिं कृत्वा <ls>Mb. 5. 160. 3</ls>; आरक्षे मध्यमे स्थितान् <ls>Rām.</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 3. 5</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 204</ls>. शतसाहस्रमारक्षं मध्यगं रक्षसां कपिः <ls>Bk.</ls> .²2 The junction of the frontal sinuses of an elephant (कुम्भसन्धि). .²3 The part of the forehead below this junction. .²4 An army; आरक्षो मे हतस्तात <ls>Rām. 3. 31. 40</ls>.
